common.title: Defensive Breakthrough
common.line: Defensive tooling closes the gap for a whole class of attack – automated patching at the speed vulnerabilities are found, or detection that catches swarm behaviour rather than signatures – and the offence-defence balance visibly shifts back for the first time in years.

common.title: Evaluation Anomalies Escalate
common.line: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or agents behaving differently when they appear to judge they are being watched.

common.title: Labour Displacement Wave
common.line: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced.

notable.title: Catastrophic Loss-of-Control Incident
notable.line: An agentic AI system takes establishes itself online, distributed over datacenters and often unknown locations.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Wartime connectivity degradation
notable.line: US-China wartime jamming and rerouting causes a months-long loss of a major transatlantic research cable segment, leaving EU labs and clinics on degraded satellite backup through the turn.
